df3.caption: 3 - Located in a line tangent to array AR-2 and running for hundreds of feet is a row of concrete pillars about three feet high with numbers stamped into a metal strap poured into the top of the pillar. The posts are marked (first post(s) in a tangle of undergrowth) 50-00, 56-40, 60-00, 86-40, (another post in dense undergrowth), 80-00, 83-20, 86-40, 90-00, 100-00, 110-00, 120-00, 130-00, 140-00, 150-00.

df4_ln927_08.caption: 4 - Closeup of a concrete post with numbers on top.

df4_74.caption: 4 - Closeup of a concrete post with numbers on top.

dfmapx.caption: Here is a map marked with the approximate location of the posts.

df5.caption: 5 - AR-1 Low band array is at the end of the trail/road. You can drive to this one.

dfar2_ln927_10.caption: 6 - AR-2 High band array off to the northwest across a ditch and through the woods. Boots are necessary to get here. The small trees make it hard to find.
